title: OpenAI restores 5-hour Codex and Work limits for ChatGPT Plus users - 9to5Mac
summary: Following several weeks during which ChatGPT users were subject only to a weekly usage cap, OpenAI announced today that it is restoring a five-hour limit on Codex and ChatGPT Work for Plus subscribers.
